option.luattf.desc: Change the font of lua (if lua is not set).
option.opponentfe.desc: If unchecked, the flickering effect will be canceled after the Bot hits.
option.sidehud.desc: If unchecked, values such as Sick, Good on the left side of the game will not be displayed.
option.blurnote.desc: If checked, the note will have a motion blur effect.
option.imv4sc.desc: If checked, the color of scoreTxt will change to the color of your opponent's healthBar.
option.oldmodsmenu.desc: If checked, the old mods menu will be used instead of the new one.
option.noteSplashes.desc: If unchecked, hitting "Sick!" notes won't show particles.
option.hideHud.desc: If checked, hides most HUD elements.
option.timeBarType.desc: What should the Time Bar display?
option.flashing.desc: Uncheck this if you're sensitive to flashing lights!
option.camZooms.desc: If unchecked, the camera won't zoom in on a beat hit.
option.scoreZoom.desc: If unchecked, disables the Score text zooming every time you hit a note.
option.healthBarAlpha.desc: How much transparent should the health bar and icons be.
option.pauseMusic.desc: What song do you prefer for the Pause Screen?
option.checkForUpdates.desc: On Release builds, turn this on to check for updates when you start the game.
option.comboStacking.desc: If unchecked, Ratings and Combo won't stack, saving on System Memory and making them easier to read.
option.lowQuality.desc: If checked, disables some background details, decreases loading times and improves performance.
option.globalAntialiasing.desc: If unchecked, disables anti-aliasing, increases performance at the cost of sharper visuals.
option.shaders.desc: If unchecked, disables shaders. It's used for some visual effects, and also CPU intensive for weaker PCs.
option.framerate.desc: How many times per second the game logic updates (physics, animations, input).
option.drawFramerate.desc:
How many frames per second the game renders at.
Can be higher than Update Framerate for smooth visuals on high-refresh monitors.
Works best when Separate Update/Draw is enabled.
option.cacheOnGPU.desc:
If checked, allows the GPU to be used for caching textures, decreasing RAM usage.
Don't turn this on if you have a shitty Graphics Card.
option.preloadAssets.desc:
If checked, preloads script images before gameplay with a loading screen.
Reduces lag during songs at the cost of initial load time.
option.windowedmode.desc: Choose your window mode (Press ACCEPT to apply changes).
option.controllerMode.desc: Check this if you want to play with a controller instead of using your Keyboard.
option.compatibility_mode.desc: If checked, lua will use the Psych Engine 0.7.3 method to be compatible with Psych Engine 0.7.3 mods.
option.downScroll.desc: If checked, notes go Down instead of Up, simple enough.
option.middleScroll.desc: If checked, your notes get centered.
option.opponentStrums.desc: If unchecked, opponent notes get hidden.
option.ghostTapping.desc: If checked, you won't get misses from pressing keys while there are no notes able to be hit.
option.noReset.desc: If checked, pressing Reset won't do anything.
option.smoothhpbar.desc:
If checked, the HP bar and icon movements will become smoother.
For some levels, there may be unspeakable bugs and performance penalty.
option.trackAlpha.desc: Changes the opacity of the note underlay.
option.hitsoundVolume.desc: Funny notes do "Tick!" when you hit them.
option.ratingOffset.desc:
Changes how late/early you have to hit for a "Sick!".
Higher values mean you have to hit later.
option.sickWindow.desc: Changes the amount of time you have for hitting a "Sick!" in milliseconds.
option.goodWindow.desc: Changes the amount of time you have for hitting a "Good" in milliseconds.
option.badWindow.desc: Changes the amount of time you have for hitting a "Bad" in milliseconds.
option.tipText: Press C to customize your android controls.
option.safeFrames.desc: Changes how many frames you have for hitting a note earlier or late.
option.sustainsAsOneNote.desc:
If checked, Hold Notes can't be pressed if you miss, and count as a single Hit/Miss.
Uncheck this if you prefer the old Input System.
option.saveReplayData.desc:
If checked, the game will record your inputs and save them with your score.
This allows you to watch replays later.
option.lastNoteAnimation.desc: If checked, character animation will only use the last pressed note's direction when multiple notes are hit simultaneously, reducing visual twitching.
option.hscriptErrorHandling.desc: If checked, Hscript will handle errors the same way as LUA, which may have some impact on Hscript.
option.extrasettings.title: Extra Settings
option.newchartingstate.desc: If checked, the new charting state will be used instead of the old one.
option.oldPauseMenu.desc: If checked, the old 0.6.3-style pause menu with Alphabet list will be used instead of the new acrylic one.
option.autoExtractAssets.desc:
If enabled, the game will automatically extract necessary assets from the APK on first launch.
Disable this if you have manually placed assets and want faster startup.
option.nativeInputDialog.desc: When enabled, clicking a text box will open a native OS input window, fixing IME candidate/override window not showing.
option.backup.export.desc: Export all game data (scores, settings, progress) to a single encrypted backup file.
option.backup.import.desc: Restore all game data from a previously created backup file.
DataBackup.success.title: Backup Successful
DataBackup.error.title: Backup Failed
DataBackup.error.message: Failed to save backup file. Please try again.
DataBackup.error.empty: The selected file is empty or invalid.
DataBackup.error.invalidFile: The selected file is not a valid backup file or has been corrupted.
DataBackup.error.fileError: An error occurred while reading the file.
DataBackup.confirm.title: Restore Data?
DataBackup.confirm.message:
This will overwrite ALL current game data (scores, settings, progress) with the data from the backup file.

This action cannot be undone!

Are you sure you want to continue?
DataBackup.restored.title: Restore Successful
DataBackup.restored.message:
Game data has been successfully restored!

The game will now reload to apply changes.
DataBackup.androidWarning.title: Important: Data Backup Recommended
DataBackup.androidWarning.message:
Your game data (scores, settings, progress) is stored in the app's internal storage.

If you uninstall or reinstall the game, ALL data may be permanently lost!

We strongly recommend creating a backup now to save your progress.

Would you like to create a backup now?
DataBackup.info:
Backup includes: Highscores, song ratings, settings, keybinds,
score history, replay data, and week progress.
Saved as an encrypted .SEB file.
option.gameplaySettings.title: Gameplay Settings
option.runInBackground.desc:
If checked, the game will continue running even when minimized or unfocused.
Overrides Auto Pause setting.
option.backgroundDim.desc:
If checked, the game will reduce volume when unfocused.
Only works when Run in Background is enabled.
option.separateUpdateDraw.desc:
Separates rendering from game logic so they can run at different speeds.
Game logic stays at your set framerate while rendering can go higher.
May improve FPS on high-refresh monitors without breaking physics.
option.threadedRendering.desc:
If enabled, moves rendering work to a separate thread.
Can improve performance on multi-core CPUs.
Requires game restart to take full effect.
option.highPerformanceMode.desc:
If enabled, removes the update accumulation cap
for maximum update rate. Automatically enables
Separate Update/Draw mode. No threading issues.
controls.rebinding_hint:
Hold ESC to Cancel
Hold Backspace to Delete
controls.hint_clown:
If you pressed Accept in Gamepad mode and nothing happened…
next time don't come to this setting without a controller!
option.traceConsole.desc: Enable the Trace Console for real-time debug output monitoring with colored, multilingual trace messages.
option.traceConsoleLevel.desc: Set the minimum trace level shown in console. DEBUG shows all traces, ERROR only shows errors.
option.touchSwipe.desc:
If enabled, you can swipe/scroll by dragging with the mouse or touching the screen.
Disable if you prefer standard click-only navigation.
option.androidSettings.title: Android Settings
option.hitboxExtraToggle.desc:
If enabled, shows extra SPACE and SHIFT buttons on the hitbox.
Disable to hide them.
option.hitboxExtraPos.desc:
Choose where the extra SPACE/SHIFT buttons appear:
Bottom (default) or Top.
option.storageType.desc:
Choose how the game accesses storage.
EXTERNAL_DATA (safest) → /Android/data/<package>/files
EXTERNAL (legacy) → /storage/emulated/0/.<game>
EXTERNAL_OBB → /Android/obb/<package>
EXTERNAL_MEDIA → /Android/media/<package>

If the selected path fails, the game falls back automatically.
option.memoryOptimization.desc:
Enables automatic memory management: periodic garbage collection, cache cleanup, and memory pressure detection.
Recommended for devices with limited RAM.
option.texturePooling.desc:
Enables GPU texture reuse to reduce video memory fragmentation and allocation overhead.
Recommended for systems with a dedicated graphics processor.
option.renderQualityLevel.desc:
Adjusts the balance between rendering quality and performance.
Low: Reduced particles, no anti-aliasing, higher frame rate.
Medium: Standard effects and anti-aliasing.
High: Full visual effects and anti-aliasing.
option.mobileAggressiveOptimization.desc:
Trade visual quality for maximum memory savings.
Reduces texture cache size, allows graphics to auto-free,
and runs garbage collection more frequently.
Recommended for low-memory devices.
memoryMonitor.critical: Critical memory pressure: {mem}MB / {threshold}MB — emergency cleanup triggered.
renderOptimizer.frameBudget: Render frame exceeded budget: {elapsed}ms, ~{drawCalls} draw calls, {sprites} sprites.
gpuTextureManager.orphanWarning: Detected {count} orphaned GPU texture(s) — possible video memory leak.
